# Harbor Desk

## Platform
web

## Product Purpose
Harbor Desk is a SaaS operations console for small freight teams. Operators
need to spot late shipments, assign follow-ups, and confirm recovery without
losing the audit trail.

## Users
Dispatch leads monitor dense tables on desktop and check exceptions on a phone.

## Brand Commitments
Operational, direct, and calm under pressure. Avoid dashboard spectacle and
invented performance claims.

## Accessibility & Inclusion
Keyboard-first operation, WCAG AA contrast, and usable touch targets.
